title: 矽光子生物感測器
summary: 從表面感測、參考通道與檢出限拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate surface sensing, reference channels and detection limits, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 光學與表面
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「光學與表面」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Optics and surface through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 倏逝場感測：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「倏逝場感測」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for evanescent-field sensing, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「倏逝場感測」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。表面附近折射率變化透過模態重疊改變共振，體相與表面結合可能同時作用。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「畫倏逝場及液體接觸區，分開列體相折射率和表面覆蓋變數。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for evanescent-field sensing, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Near-surface index changes shift resonance through modal overlap; bulk and surface binding can act together. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Draw the evanescent field and fluid contact region, separating bulk index from surface coverage. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 畫倏逝場及液體接觸區，分開列體相折射率和表面覆蓋變數。
steps.observationEn: Draw the evanescent field and fluid contact region, separating bulk index from surface coverage.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：高折射率靈敏度就等於高度生物選擇性。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: High index sensitivity equals high biological selectivity. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交倏逝場感測的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「畫倏逝場及液體接觸區，分開列體相折射率和表面覆蓋變數。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for evanescent-field sensing, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Draw the evanescent field and fluid contact region, separating bulk index from surface coverage.

steps.title: 倏逝場感測：量測與判別

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Draw the evanescent field and fluid contact region, separating bulk index from surface coverage. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Near-surface index changes shift resonance through modal overlap; bulk and surface binding can act together." against the incorrect hypothesis "No fluid leakage guarantees a stable baseline."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.

steps.check: 提交倏逝場感測的量測判別表：畫倏逝場及液體接觸區，分開列體相折射率和表面覆蓋變數。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。按算例保留單位，並分別報空白噪聲、斜率與所用倍數。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「以背景標準差除以斜率估計檢出限需固定訊號定義與校正範圍。」與錯誤假說「高折射率靈敏度就等於高度生物選擇性。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假設濃度校正斜率 0.20 nm/(mg/L)，空白波長標準差 0.002 nm，以 3σ/slope 估計 LOD=0.030 mg/L。此為自訂統計示例，不是任何生物標記的診斷門檻。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Retain units in the example and report blank noise, slope and the chosen multiplier separately. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "A noise-to-slope detection limit requires fixed signal definition and calibration range." against the incorrect hypothesis "High index sensitivity equals high biological selectivity."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume calibration slope 0.20 nm/(mg/L) and blank wavelength SD 0.002 nm. A 3σ/slope estimate gives LOD=0.030 mg/L. This is a statistical teaching example, not a diagnostic cutoff for any biomarker.

steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: High index sensitivity equals high biological selectivity. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
